answer: Because the timing is recorded against the karst challenge, the cedar audit can replay the jetty history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 185 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 7 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
